hard_failures: missing, corrupt, identity-mismatched, or topology-mismatched artifact
acceptance_policy.warning_effect: record and render the state; never truncate the trajectory or exclude a checkpoint

limitations: single deterministic target and no replicate
exaggerated material amplitudes are not physiological estimates
umbrella-Laplacian values are comparable only on this fixed topology
nearest-fidelity comparison uses actual saved states and may retain a reported fidelity spread
inversion and fold counts are not proxies for visible artifact severity

matching.selection_rule: nearest actual discrete checkpoint by absolute fidelity error; ties choose the earlier step; geometry is never interpolated
matching.tau_rule: maximum terminal target-error fraction across all six cases

metric_definitions.bumpiness/contraction_target_relative_di: rest-edge-length-weighted RMS difference between deformed and target dihedral angles on contraction-ROI interior edges
metric_definitions.bumpiness/displacement_laplacian_rms: legacy fixed-topology umbrella-Laplacian RMS of displacement on the SmileLossMask surface

purpose: deliberately exaggerated mechanism contrast; not a physiological material calibration

render_policy.appearance: plain fixed color, white background, smooth shading
render_policy.surface: canonical e100-p000 skin mapped by GlobalPointId for all cases
